● Before I set up releases, two choices.

Which versioning scheme should releases use?

❯ 1. Semver
     MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, bumped from the commit types
  2. CalVer
     The year and month, like 2026.10
  3. Build number
     A counter the workflow bumps on each release
  4. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this
